title: Add GCC atomic support (-moutline-atomics) for arm64
description: Add "-moutline-atomics" cflag for arm64 architecture since it is not active by default on GCC 9. Without this flag, the CPU doesn't use atomics instructions resulting in poor performance and CPU saturation. With this change, NGINX does not produce STREX failing operations anymore (observable with perf tool).
commit_message: Add GCC atomic support (-moutline-atomics) for arm64
diff:
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 655a7e5..3c72c18 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -35,6 +35,8 @@ $(foreach flavour,$(FLAVOURS),$(eval BUILDDIR_$(flavour) = $(CURDIR)/debian/buil
 DEB_BUILD_ARCH ?=$(shell dpkg-architecture -qDEB_BUILD_ARCH)
 ifeq ($(DEB_BUILD_ARCH),sparc)
 	debian_cflags += -m32 -mcpu=ultrasparc
+else ifeq ($(DEB_BUILD_ARCH),arm64)
+	debian_cflags += -moutline-atomics
 endif
 
 ifneq (,$(filter parallel=%,$(DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS)))
